reviewer: Implementation agent; not independent or a user study
scope: Compare retained live outputs with their retrieved evidence and stated context. Citation membership is not semantic entailment.

findings.issue: An exact duration was spelled out in Russian, bypassing the digit-only lexical check.
findings.change: Reject common EN/RU/KK spelled-out durations in generated prose; instruct the model to leave timing to the itinerary. Regression tests cover all three languages.

findings.issue: Generic tree-counting mission despite a distinctive sourced architectural setting.
findings.change: Added source-specific editorial observation questions to five existing facts, in addition to seven new questions. The final park mission refers to the Palace of Peace and Reconciliation.

findings.issue: Generated viewing-platform instruction implied a facility absent from retrieved facts.
findings.change: Reject a viewing-platform/observation-deck mention without a matching retrieved fact; distinguish an ordinary public viewpoint from a built facility.

remaining: Generic category-only missions remain for unenriched places, now labelled visibly.
Some reasons still use generic praise or infer a preference from broad interests; the model is not a complete semantic verifier.
Six final cases do not establish general factuality or language quality. Native-speaker and participant review remain future work.

finalRun.retryPolicy: One explicit retry of the failed bridge case; prior fallback retained in current report.
